name: adam-procedure-eval
description:
Industrial SOP procedure eval — 20 realistic Kazakh-language probes across the 15 curated procedures in data/procedures/labor_safety_kz.jsonl.  Tests whether production routes worker / supervisor / OH&S queries to the matching procedure rather than to medical refusal / generic safety / cascade fallthrough.  Probes were composed against the actual procedure titles + steps; expected_response is a substring or token that must appear in the production answer for a semantic pass.

Accepted (was_accepted=true) probes are PRODUCTION-GATE-RELEVANT: they should pass before an industrial pilot.  Unaccepted probes document known coverage gaps.
